question: What is the value of 12 - [3 + {4 of 2 ÷ 8 - (8 - 6 ÷ 3)}]
solution:
**Given:**

12 - [3 + {4 of 2 ÷ 8 - (8 - 6 ÷ 3)}]

**Concept used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/j6RSbnNu5cJhvOGtXoHeLBHI23tptVWkhRCmGb9gSVO2j-_0KZm1NmVDP-Thq6HqRJcL6tDTCEANjFJBSQapVgaJKNpAu45P3D2PqUTcVOB--Ix2--gEd-nHlr-wb7yABGmD8VZRaCBrMAk4CjfzlQ] 

**Calculation:**

12 - [3 + {4 of 2 ÷ 8 - (8 - 6 ÷ 3)}]

⇒ 12 - [3 + {8 ÷ 8 - (8 - 2)}]

⇒ 12 - [3 + {1 - 6}]

⇒ 12 - [3 - 5]

⇒ 12 + 2

⇒ 14

**∴ The value of 12 - [3 + {4 of 2 ÷ 8 - (8 - 6 ÷ 3)}] is 14.**
